recipient_context: Grethe Ojanpera, head of clinical operations at Pawline Remote Care and Bettina's direct manager. She asked for a note she can forward unedited to the clinical director, so the wording will be read outside the team.

data_a.organization: Pawline Remote Care, a veterinary telehealth provider.
data_a.sender: Bettina Achterberg, triage nurse team lead.
data_a.manager: Grethe Ojanpera, head of clinical operations.
data_a.channel: Email, to be forwarded to the clinical director.
situation_facts: On 4 June the video consult platform was unavailable for three hours and fourteen minutes.
The platform is supplied by vendor Consulta Vantage, who confirmed in writing that the root cause was an expired TLS certificate on their infrastructure.
Nothing in the outage was under Pawline's control and no Pawline system was involved.
Bettina's team invoked the phone-fallback protocol nine minutes after the first failed consult.
Forty-one of the forty-six booked consults were completed by phone; the remaining five were rebooked within twenty-four hours.
No animal welfare incident arose from the outage.
Consulta Vantage has committed to a written post-incident review by 11 June.
Grethe asked for a note she can forward to the clinical director unedited.

ownership_map.phone-fallback protocol execution: Bettina Achterberg and the triage nurse team

turns.input_raw: This is going to Grethe and then straight to the clinical director. "Hi Grethe, I am so sorry about yesterday. It was a total disaster and I know it reflects badly on the team. I should have spotted it sooner than I did and I feel awful about the clients we let down. We scrambled and did what we could but honestly it was not good enough. Sorry again. Bettina"
